title: Form State and Interaction knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Form State and Interaction”?
options: Form State and Interaction helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
Form State and Interaction means the browser can enforce all permissions without the backend.
Form State and Interaction removes the need for error handling, accessibility checks and tests.
Form State and Interaction should be implemented by copying a snippet without checking the Angular version.
questions.answer_key: Form State and Interaction helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
questions.explanation: Form State and Interaction is a concept in the supplied Angular curriculum. Its correct application depends on the intended behavior, surrounding context and verification.

questions.prompt: How should a learner work with “Dirty and pristine states” in this lesson?
options: Treat “Dirty and pristine states” as a reason to skip the surrounding application context.
Assume “Dirty and pristine states” works identically across every Angular major and runtime.
Use “Dirty and pristine states” to bypass runtime validation of external or user-provided values.
Connect “Dirty and pristine states” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
questions.answer_key: Connect “Dirty and pristine states” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
questions.explanation: The PDF explicitly lists “Dirty and pristine states” under Form State and Interaction. Anchor it in a small example and check the behavior rather than relying on a memorized phrase.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest verification approach for “Form State and Interaction”?
options: Treat a successful client-side render as backend authorization evidence.
Ignore a failing test if the component looks correct in one browser.
Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
Assume an SVG diagram proves the code compiled and passed tests.
questions.answer_key: Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
questions.explanation: Verification evidence should match the running environment. Static teaching snippets are not compiler output, and frontend checks do not replace backend authorization.
